title: Peanut Butter Energy Balls
description: No-bake bites combining oats, peanut butter and protein powder for a quick pre-workout energy boost.
steps: Mix the oats, peanut butter, protein powder and honey into a firm dough.
Chill 30 minutes, then roll into bite-sized balls.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge.
notes: Batch these on Sunday and keep refrigerated — grab one before training for steady energy without a sugar spike.
